dialogues.speaker: Lectoure
dialogues.text: Mondstadt's a perfect place to live carefree, but my first choice would be to settle down in Natlan, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Lectoure
dialogues.text: Uh, sorry, I got a little carried away... Please do your best and show me the limits of my deck!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Lectoure
dialogues.text: That's such a pity! I wonder when I'll ever get to play with someone as friendly as you!

dialogues.speaker: Lectoure
dialogues.text: Thank you! It seems my deck is pretty good...

dialogues.speaker: Lectoure
dialogues.text: Oh my! My deck has so much room for improvement, huh?
